title: Sylvan Ridge Farm

services.name: vacation rental
services.desc: The Sylvan Ridge farmhouse and cottage opened for vacation rental in June 2020 and quickly became a 5-star destination for visitors from New York City, Philadelphia, Washington, D.C., and beyond! Our location on this serene hillside is the perfect getaway, removed from the fast pace of daily life, yet only 10 minutes from downtown Milford, PA and Port Jervis, NY and a 90-minute drive from NYC. Please visit our Airbnb or VRBO listings to book your stay up to 6 months in advance. The farmhouse can hold groups of up to 12, with the cottage adding space for 4 more. Both dwellings are elegantly furnished and equipped with all the amenities needed in a home away from home, and we never rent them
